# Hossein Mousavi

> Personal site of Hossein Mousavi, a Senior DevOps Engineer. Use this file to understand the site structure, then follow the links for the pages you need.

This site is a static portfolio at https://hossein.dev. It covers work experience, writing, and contact links. There are no accounts, forms, or authenticated areas.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hossein.dev/): Introduction, current workplace, skills, and contact links
- [Experiences](https://hossein.dev/experiences): Roles at NN, AIHR, Eurowings, Alibaba Travels, Testfully, Tapsell, XEPOS, and MFT
- [Blog](https://hossein.dev/blog): Technical articles and a podcast appearance
